# TinyForge Game Tools
TinyForge Game Tools is a small collection of focused game-balancing utilities for indie game developers.

Canonical site: https://nikos0207.github.io/tinyforge-tools/

## Free browser tools
- DropChance: https://nikos0207.github.io/tinyforge-tools/dropchance/ — drop-rate probability, expected attempts and confidence thresholds.
- Hard Pity Calculator: https://nikos0207.github.io/tinyforge-tools/pity-calculator/ — hard-pity average attempts and worst-case cap.
- XP & Leveling Time Calculator: https://nikos0207.github.io/tinyforge-tools/xp-calculator/ — progression XP, hours and session estimates.
- Game Economy Faucet & Sink Calculator: https://nikos0207.github.io/tinyforge-tools/economy-calculator/ — simple currency flow and inflation-pressure estimate.

## Paid tools
- GrindScope — XP progression visualizer: https://nikos0207.itch.io/grindscope-xp-progression-visualizer
- EconScope — game economy stress tester: https://nikos0207.itch.io/econscope-game-economy-stress-tester
- LootSim — loot table and dry-streak simulator: https://nikos0207.itch.io/lootsim-loot-table-dry-streak-simulator
- Current bundle: https://nikos0207.itch.io/s/202514/tinyforge-7-day-game-balancing-toolkit
